create_session: create a Session instance with an optional node_map and action_registry
get_node_map: get the NodeMap from a Session instance using the get_node_map method
dispatch_wire_message: dispatch a WireMessage to the Session asynchronously via a WireStream
dispatch_from_stream: start dispatching messages from a WireStream to the Session
stop_dispatching_from_stream: stop dispatching messages from a WireStream to the Session
